title: Yap – OSS on-device voice dictation for macOS with no model to download

zh.gap: 端上听写工具默认你只说一种语言；而那个承诺「什么都不出本机」的，在老机器上其实悄悄把声音发去了服务器。

voices.quote: I'd love to be able to dictate in 2 langu[ages]
voices.zh: 我很希望能用两种语言口述。

voices.quote: Yep sends all audio data to Apple servers (on Intel Macs)
voices.zh: 是的，（在 Intel 芯片的 Mac 上）它会把所有音频数据发到苹果的服务器。

zh.pain: 一句话里中英混说的人：不切系统语言就没法把这句话口述出来。而 macOS 上看起来最诚实的那个本地方案，在 Intel 机器上会静默回落到苹果的服务器——「什么都不出这台机器」那句话没把这件事说出来。
zh.kill: 这是一家融资公司的副产品仓，而苹果自带听写就在设置里一个开关之外；薄薄一层封装，一个周末就能被复刻。
zh.move: 只做双语者：一种语言一个热键，一句话里中英混说不用切换，整理时认得出哪些是另一种语言的专名，全程不出本机。 冷启动第一步：中文＝小红书与 V2EX 的「语音输入法 中英混说」帖；英文＝Yap 自己的 issue #2 与 #15，以及 r/macapps。

pick_reason: Yap addresses a clear need for on-device voice dictation with a unique selling point of no model downloads, appealing to privacy-conscious users.

voices.quote: I'd love to be able to dictate in 2 langu[ages]
voices.text: I'd love to be able to dictate in 2 langu[ages]

voices.quote: Yep sends all audio data to Apple servers (on Intel Macs)
voices.text: Yep sends all audio data to Apple servers (on Intel Macs)

gap: It hits a real pain but solves it imperfectly, and the privacy promise has a hole: on Intel Macs it falls back to Apple's servers, which the README's 'nothing leaves your machine' framing does not make obvious. There is also no way to dictate in a language other than the system locale — the single most-requested thing in the tracker — which quietly excludes every bilingual user.
pain: The bilingual person who talks half in Chinese and half in English and cannot dictate one sentence without switching the system language — and the one honest-looking local option on macOS quietly falls back to Apple's servers on Intel machines, which the 'nothing leaves your machine' framing does not say out loud.
kill: This is a funded startup's side repo (Frigade), so the opening is theirs to close, and macOS ships dictation for free one settings toggle away. A thin wrapper over an Apple API is a weekend to clone and has no asset that compounds.
move: The wedge is not transcription, it is the bilingual person Apple ignores: one hotkey per language, mixed Chinese-English in a single sentence without switching anything, and cleanup that knows which words are proper nouns in the other language. Ship on-device only and say so honestly — no silent server fallback. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 and V2EX threads on 「语音输入法 中英混说」, where bilingual users complain that every dictation tool forces one language; Cold start (English): the Yap tracker itself (issues #2 and #15 are the request), plus r/macapps.
